notes.title: 🎮 Gamepad Support is Here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve got some exciting news – [b]Bug Bane now supports gamepads!
[/b]
Whether you’re a couch gamer or just prefer a controller in hand, you can now dive into the chaos however you like.[/p][p]This is just the beginning of making Bug Bane feel even smoother and more fun to play. Grab your controller, jump in, and let us know how it feels.[/p][p]Thanks for all your support, and happy bug-busting!
– The Bug Bane Dev[/p]
